summary: Root, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $200.0 million senior secured term loan credit agreement with Caret Holdings as borrower, lenders, and Huntington National Bank as agent, and termination of its existing term loan agreement. The loan accrues interest at ABR or Term SOFR plus margins of 2.00%-2.75% or 3.00%-3.75%, matures May 4, 2029, is guaranteed and secured by substantially all assets, and includes financial covenants. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation. The filing includes operational and financial disclosure items.
